hook: Material strength may have let the Moon form intact hours after impact
what_happened: SPH simulations with temperature-dependent geologic strength found a hot but solid Theia is captured as an intact Moon, emerging within about five hours
why_it_matters: It challenges modeling the collision as pure fluid, and hints the Moon’s formation may be tied to how hot Earth and Theia were
the_catch: In every scenario the Moon still comes mostly from Theia’s mantle, so strength does not solve why Earth and the Moon match compositionally
caption: New simulations suggest the Moon could have formed intact, reshaping our view of its birth
alt_text: Carousel explaining how including material strength in simulations shows the Moon could form intact hours after a giant collision
attribution: Denton et al., The Astrophysical Journal Letters (2026)

es.hook: La resistencia del material pudo haber permitido que la Luna se formara intacta horas después del impacto
es.what_happened: Las simulaciones SPH con resistencia geológica dependiente de la temperatura mostraron que una Theia caliente pero sólida se captura como una Luna intacta, emergiendo en unas cinco horas
es.why_it_matters: Desafía el modelado de la colisión como fluido puro y sugiere que la formación de la Luna puede estar vinculada a cuán calientes estaban la Tierra y Theia
es.the_catch: En todos los escenarios la Luna proviene mayormente del manto de Theia, por lo que la resistencia no resuelve por qué la Tierra y la Luna coinciden en composición
